verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is self-hosted, so your data stays on your own infrastructure. It can stream proxy inputs, outputs and exceptions to open sinks you control, such as OpenTelemetry, S3, GCS and Azure Blob. Its OpenAI-format responses and drop-in OpenAI compatibility also lower switching costs. However, nothing shows a documented feature for exporting all stored data (virtual keys, users, teams, spend records, memory) in an open format. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export or migration tool, documented export formats for admin and spend data, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving cleanly.
